textual.potential_relevance: A stated monthly-expense earning outcome is connected to joining the platform, completing tests and training, uploading documents for verification, and answering questions for stated per-question payments.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish whether the platform, payout rate, document process, or projected monthly amount is accurate. The ASR renders the platform name inconsistently as "check," "cheque," and "CHECK," while the title says "Chegg"; no external identity or transaction verification is available.
